description: This file defines the I18NImportErrorDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the I18NImportError entity, providing methods to set related entities based on identifiers, facilitating error handling during internationalization import processes.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for I18NImportError entity that provides methods to associate related entities such as language, error type, and employee based on identifiers.

methods.name: setImportError
methods.description: Sets the I18NImportError entity to be decorated.

methods.name: setLangStringById
methods.description: Associates an I18NLangString entity with the import error based on its ID.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Associates an I18NLanguage entity with the import error based on its ID.

methods.name: setErrorByName
methods.description: Associates an I18NError entity with the import error based on the error name.

methods.name: setImportedEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the import error based on employee number.
